title_zh: 萬松老人評唱天童頌古 從容錄
title_pinyin: Wànsōng Lǎorén Píngchàng Tiāntóng Sònggǔ Cóngróng Lù
title_en: The Book of Serenity (Congrong Lu / Shoyoroku)
author_zh: 天童正覺 頌古 / 萬松行秀 評唱
author_en: Verses by Hongzhi Zhengjue (1091–1157), Commentaries by Wansong Xingxiu (1166–1246)
genre: Caodong Gong'an & Songgu Masterwork (公案與評唱)
overview: The definitive Caodong (Soto) counterpart to the Blue Cliff Record, uniting the poetic subtlety of Master Hongzhi Zhengjue with the vast, encyclopedic commentaries of Master Wansong Xingxiu of the Hermitage of Serenity.

cases.title_en: The World-Honored One Ascends the Seat: The Law of the Dharma King is Thus
cases.pointer_zh: 示眾云：閉門造車，出門合轍。正當開口不得，進退無門之時，作麼生委悉？
cases.pointer_en: Pointer: Making a cart behind closed doors, going out the door it fits the tracks. Right when you cannot open your mouth and there is no room to advance or retreat, how do you comprehend?

dialogue.speaker: Narrative / 本事
dialogue.zh: 世尊一日陞座。大眾才集，文殊白槌云：「諦觀法王法，法王法如是。」世尊便下座。
dialogue.pinyin: Shìzūn yī rì shēngzuò. Dàzhòng cái jí, Wénshū bái chuí yún: 'Dì guān fǎwáng fǎ, fǎwáng fǎ rúshì.' Shìzūn biàn xiàzuò.

cleary.text: One day the World-Honored One ascended the seat. As the crowd gathered, Manjushri struck the gavel and said, 'Clearly observe the Dharma of the King of Dharma; the Dharma of the King of Dharma is thus!' The World-Honored One then got down from the seat.

red_pine.text: One day the World-Honored One ascended the teaching seat. As the assembly gathered, Manjushri struck the gavel and announced: 'Clearly observe the Dharma of the Dharma King; the Dharma of the Dharma King is thus!' The World-Honored One immediately stepped down from the seat.

sasaki.text: One day the World-Honored One ascended the platform. Manjushri struck the gavel: 'Carefully behold the Law of the King of the Law; the Law of the King of the Law is thus!' The Buddha descended from his seat.

cases.commentary_zh: 萬松曰：世尊全提正令，文殊一槌擊碎萬象。不著文字，不犯窠臼，天然本具。
cases.commentary_pinyin: Wànsōng yuē: Shìzūn quán tí zhèng lìng, Wénshū yī chuí jī suì wànxiàng. Bù zhuó wénzì, bù fàn kējiù, tiānrán běnjù.
cases.commentary_en: Wansong says: The World-Honored One brings forth the official order completely; Manjushri shatters myriad forms with a single stroke of the gavel. Not clinging to words and letters, not falling into worn ruts, it is naturally complete from the beginning.
cases.verse_zh: 秋風瑟瑟水連天，月白松青萬境玄。文殊一槌驚睡雁，不知身在碧雲巔。
cases.verse_pinyin: Qiūfēng sèsè shuǐ liántiān, yuè bái sōng qīng wàn jìng xuán. Wénshū yī chuí jīng shuì yàn, bù zhī shēn zài bìyún diān.
cases.verse_en: The autumn breeze soughs, water merges with sky; / The moon is white, pines green, all realms profound. / Manjushri's single gavel startles the sleeping wild geese, / Not knowing they are flying atop the emerald clouds!

cases.title_zh: 梁武帝問達摩：廓然無聖
cases.title_pinyin: Liáng Wǔdì Wèn Dámó: Kuò Rán Wú Shèng
cases.title_en: Emperor Wu of Liang Asks Bodhidharma: Vast Emptiness, No Holiness
cases.pointer_zh: 示眾云：有乾坤已來，這一著子，莫有會得者麼？
cases.pointer_en: Pointer: Since heaven and earth began, has there been anyone who could comprehend this one move?

dialogue.speaker: Main Case / 本則
dialogue.zh: 梁武帝問達摩大師：「如何是聖諦第一義？」摩云：「廓然無聖。」帝云：「對朕者誰？」摩云：「不識。」帝不契。達摩遂渡江至魏。
dialogue.pinyin: Liáng Wǔdì wèn Dámó Dàshī: 'Rúhé shì shèngdì dìyī yì?' Mó yún: 'Kuò rán wú shèng.' Dì yún: 'Duì zhèn zhě shuí?' Mó yún: 'Bù shí.' Dì bù qì. Dámó suì dù jiāng zhì Wèi.

cleary.text: Emperor Wu of Liang asked Great Master Bodhidharma, 'What is the highest meaning of the holy truths?' Bodhidharma said, 'Vast emptiness, no holiness.' The Emperor said, 'Who is confronting us?' Bodhidharma said, 'I don't know.' The Emperor did not understand. Bodhidharma then crossed the river and went to Wei.

red_pine.text: Emperor Wu of Liang asked Great Master Bodhidharma, 'What is the first principle of the holy teaching?' Bodhidharma replied, 'Vast emptiness, no holiness.' The Emperor said, 'Who is standing before us?' Bodhidharma said, 'Not knowing.' The Emperor did not harmonize. Bodhidharma crossed the river to Wei.

sasaki.text: Emperor Wu of Liang asked Great Master Bodhidharma, 'What is the first principle of the holy teaching?' Bodhidharma replied, 'Vast emptiness, no holiness.' The Emperor said, 'Who is standing before us?' Bodhidharma said, 'Not knowing.' The Emperor did not harmonize. Bodhidharma crossed the river to Wei.

cases.commentary_zh: 萬松老人云：此一則公案，直指人心，不可用思量卜度。
cases.commentary_en: Wansong says: This case points directly to the human mind; it cannot be measured by intellectual speculation.
cases.verse_zh: 天童頌云：古佛心印，直下透徹。
cases.verse_en: Hongzhi's verse: The ancient Buddha's seal of mind penetrates straight to the bottom.

cases.title_en: Nanquan Cuts the Cat in Two: The Straw Sandals on the Head
cases.pointer_zh: 示眾云：截鐵斬釘，臨機不斷。透得這箇關捩子，方見祖師向上家風。
cases.pointer_en: Pointer: Cutting through iron and severing nails, when meeting the moment do not hesitate. If you penetrate this pivot, you see the ultimate ancestral family style.

dialogue.speaker: Narrative / 本事
dialogue.zh: 南泉因兩堂爭貓，提起云：「道得即救，道不得即斬卻。」眾無對，泉斬之。趙州晚歸，泉舉示。州脫草鞋安頭上出。泉曰：「子若在，恰救得貓兒。」
dialogue.pinyin: Nánquán yīn liǎngtáng zhēng māo, tíqǐ yún: 'Dào dé jí jiù, dào bù dé jí zhǎn què.' Zhòng wú duì, Quán zhǎn zhī. Zhàozhōu wǎn guī, Quán jǔ shì. Zhōu tuō cǎoxié ān tóu shàng chū. Quán yuē: 'Zǐ ruò zài, qià jiù dé māo'er.'

cleary.text: Because the two halls were disputing over a cat, Nanquan held it up and said, 'If you can speak, you save it; if not, I'll cut it.' The crowd had no reply; Nanquan cut it. Zhaozhou returned in the evening; Nanquan told him. Zhaozhou took off his straw sandals, put them on his head, and went out. Nanquan said, 'Had you been here, you'd have saved the cat.'

red_pine.text: Because the Eastern and Western halls fought over a cat, Nanquan lifted it up: 'If you can speak, you save it; if not, I will cut it in two.' The monks made no reply; Nanquan cut it. Zhaozhou returned in the evening; Nanquan told him. Zhaozhou took off his straw sandals, placed them on his head, and walked out. Nanquan said: 'Had you been here, you would have saved the cat.'

sasaki.text: Nansen held up the cat: 'Speak and save it; if not, I cut it.' The monks were silent; Nansen cut it in two. Jōshū put his straw sandals on his head and walked out. Nansen said: 'Had you been here, you would have saved it.'

cases.commentary_zh: 萬松曰：南泉提起貓兒，全提殺活大用。趙州頂戴草鞋，倒轉機輪。一人行正令，一人見生機。
cases.commentary_pinyin: Wànsōng yuē: Nánquán tíqǐ māo'er, quán tí shā huó dàyòng. Zhàozhōu dǐngdài cǎoxié, dào zhuǎn jīlún. Yī rén xíng zhèng lìng, yī rén jiàn shēngjī.
cases.commentary_en: Wansong says: When Nanquan lifted the cat, he brought forth the great functioning of killing and reviving. When Zhaozhou put the sandals on his head, he turned around the wheel of potential. One executed the official decree; the other demonstrated the living vitality.
cases.verse_zh: 公案圓成沒奈何，掀翻窠臼起風波。趙州頭上草鞋出，滿地清光照古河。
cases.verse_pinyin: Gōng'àn yuánchéng mò nàihé, xiānfān kējiù qǐ fēngbō. Zhàozhōu tóu shàng cǎoxié chū, mǎndì qīngguāng zhào gǔ hé.
cases.verse_en: The gong'an is fully accomplished with no excuse; / Overturning all worn traps, raising wind and waves! / Zhaozhou walks out with straw sandals on his head; / The whole earth is covered in pure light illuminating the ancient river!

cases.title_pinyin: Nǚzǐ Chū Dìng: Wǎngmíng Chū Dìng
cases.title_en: The Woman in Samadhi: Wangming Brings Her Out of Samadhi
cases.pointer_zh: 示眾云：萬法歸一，一歸何處？若知此去處，便見出定之方。
cases.pointer_en: Pointer: The ten thousand dharmas return to one; where does the one return? If you know this destination, you see the method of emerging from samadhi.

dialogue.speaker: Main Case / 本則
dialogue.zh: 世尊昔至忉利天為母說法。文殊白佛：「還可令女子出定否？」世尊云：「非但汝，百千文殊亦不能令此女子出定。下方過十二億恆河沙國，有罔明菩薩，能令此女子出定。」
dialogue.pinyin: Shìzūn xī zhì Dāolì Tiān wèi mǔ shuō fǎ. Wénshū bái Fó: 'Hái kě lìng nǚzǐ chū dìng fǒu?' Shìzūn yún: 'Fēi dàn rǔ, bǎi qiān Wénshū yì bù néng lìng cǐ nǚzǐ chū dìng. Xià fāng guò shí'èr yì hénghéshā guó, yǒu Wǎngmíng Púsà, néng lìng cǐ nǚzǐ chū dìng.'

cleary.text: Long ago the World-Honored One went to the Trayastrimsha Heaven to preach to his mother. Manjushri asked the Buddha, 'Can we bring this woman out of samadhi?' The World-Honored One said, 'Not only you, but hundreds and thousands of Manjushris could not bring this woman out of samadhi. Down below, past twelve billion lands as numerous as the sands of the Ganges, there is Wangming Bodhisattva who can bring this woman out of samadhi.'

red_pine.text: When the Buddha was in the Trayastrimsha Heaven teaching his mother, Manjushri asked, 'Can this woman be awakened from samadhi?' The Buddha replied, 'Even a hundred thousand Manjushris could not rouse her. But twelve billion Buddha-lands below sits the Bodhisattva of Unclear Light; he can rouse her.'

sasaki.text: When the Buddha was in the Trayastrimsha Heaven teaching his mother, Manjushri asked, 'Can this woman be awakened from samadhi?' The Buddha replied, 'Even a hundred thousand Manjushris could not rouse her. But twelve billion Buddha-lands below sits the Bodhisattva of Unclear Light; he can rouse her.'

cases.title_pinyin: Kuò Shìzhě Diǎn Chá: Chī Chá Qù
cases.title_en: Attendant Kuo Serving Tea: Have a Cup of Tea
cases.pointer_zh: 示眾云：門前有一條大路，往來無滯；為甚麼行路人皆被腳下絆倒？
cases.pointer_en: Pointer: Before the gate lies a great highway where traffic moves without hindrance; why do all wayfarers stumble over their own feet?

dialogue.speaker: Main Case / 本則
dialogue.zh: 趙州問廓侍者：「曾到這裏否？」云：「曾到。」州云：「喫茶去。」又問別僧：「曾到這裏否？」云：「不曾到。」州云：「喫茶去。」
dialogue.pinyin: Zhàozhōu wèn Kuò shìzhě: 'Céng dào zhèlǐ fǒu?' Yún: 'Céng dào.' Zhōu yún: 'Chī chá qù.' Yòu wèn bié sēng: 'Céng dào zhèlǐ fǒu?' Yún: 'Bù céng dào.' Zhōu yún: 'Chī chá qù.'

cleary.text: Zhaozhou asked Attendant Kuo, 'Have you ever been here before?' Kuo said, 'Yes, I have.' Zhaozhou said, 'Go have a cup of tea.' Then he asked another monk, 'Have you ever been here before?' The monk said, 'No, never.' Zhaozhou said, 'Go have a cup of tea.'

red_pine.text: Zhaozhou asked an attendant, 'Have you been here before?' 'I have,' said the monk. 'Go drink some tea,' Zhaozhou replied. Later he asked a newcomer, 'Have you been here before?' 'I have not,' said the monk. 'Go drink some tea,' Zhaozhou replied.

sasaki.text: Zhaozhou asked an attendant, 'Have you been here before?' 'I have,' said the monk. 'Go drink some tea,' Zhaozhou replied. Later he asked a newcomer, 'Have you been here before?' 'I have not,' said the monk. 'Go drink some tea,' Zhaozhou replied.

cases.commentary_en: Wansong says: This case points directly to the human mind; it cannot be measured by intellectual speculation.

cases.verse_en: Hongzhi's verse: The ancient Buddha's seal of mind penetrates straight to the bottom.

cases.title_en: Jizo's Not Knowing is Most Intimate
cases.pointer_zh: 示眾云：明眼漢沒窠臼，到處逍遙。為甚麼路上著腳不得？
cases.pointer_en: Pointer: A clear-eyed man has no fixed tracks and roams free everywhere. Why can't he place a foot on the road?

dialogue.speaker: Main Case / 本則
dialogue.zh: 地藏問法眼：「上座何往？」眼云：「行腳去。」藏云：「行腳事作麼生？」眼云：「不知。」藏云：「不知最親。」法眼於是豁然大悟。
dialogue.pinyin: Dìzàng wèn Fǎyǎn: 'Shàngzuò hé wǎng?' Yǎn yún: 'Xíngjiǎo qù.' Zàng yún: 'Xíngjiǎo shì zuò mò shēng?' Yǎn yún: 'Bù zhī.' Zàng yún: 'Bù zhī zuì qīn.' Fǎyǎn yúshì huò rán dà wù.

cleary.text: Jizo asked Fayan, 'Where are you going, elder monk?' Fayan said, 'On pilgrimage.' Jizo asked, 'What is the matter of pilgrimage?' Fayan said, 'I don't know.' Jizo said, 'Not knowing is most intimate.' At these words, Fayan was suddenly and thoroughly enlightened.

red_pine.text: Master Dizang asked Fayan, 'Where are you heading?' Fayan said, 'Wandering on pilgrimage.' Dizang asked, 'What is the purpose of pilgrimage?' Fayan said, 'I do not know.' Dizang said, 'Not knowing is most intimate.' Hearing this, Fayan awoke.

sasaki.text: Master Dizang asked Fayan, 'Where are you heading?' Fayan said, 'Wandering on pilgrimage.' Dizang asked, 'What is the purpose of pilgrimage?' Fayan said, 'I do not know.' Dizang said, 'Not knowing is most intimate.' Hearing this, Fayan awoke.

cases.pointer_zh: 示眾云：天地同一指，萬物同一馬；更須知有超越的一句。
cases.pointer_en: Pointer: Heaven and earth are one finger; the ten thousand things are one horse. Yet you must know there is a phrase that transcends all.

dialogue.speaker: Main Case / 本則
dialogue.zh: 雲門示眾云：「露柱與燈籠交涉，作麼生？」眾無對。自代云：「雲在青天水在瓶。」
dialogue.pinyin: Yúnmén shì zhòng yún: 'Lùzhù yǔ dēnglóng jiāoshè, zuò mò shēng?' Zhòng wú duì. Zì dài yún: 'Yún zài qīngtiān shuǐ zài píng.'

cleary.text: Yunmen addressed the assembly, saying: 'What is the interaction between a pillar and a lantern?' The assembly had no answer. Yunmen answered for them: 'Clouds in the blue sky, water in the jug.'

red_pine.text: Master Yunmen asked the monks, 'How do the wooden pillar and the stone lantern converse?' When no one answered, he said for them, 'Clouds in the blue sky, water in the jug.'

sasaki.text: Master Yunmen asked the monks, 'How do the wooden pillar and the stone lantern converse?' When no one answered, he said for them, 'Clouds in the blue sky, water in the jug.'

cases.title_en: Mazu's Sun Face Buddha, Moon Face Buddha
cases.pointer_zh: 示眾云：有病無病，本體不遷；長命短命，同歸一路。
cases.pointer_en: Pointer: Whether sick or well, the original substance never shifts; whether long-lived or short-lived, all return along the same road.

dialogue.speaker: Main Case / 本則
dialogue.zh: 馬祖不安。院主問：「和尚近日尊候如何？」祖云：「日面佛，月面佛。」
dialogue.pinyin: Mǎzǔ bù ān. Yuànzhǔ wèn: 'Héshang jìnrì zūnhòu rúhé?' Zǔ yún: 'Rì miàn Fó, yuè miàn Fó.'

cleary.text: Master Mazu was unwell. The temple superintendent asked, 'How is the Master's venerable health these days?' Mazu said, 'Sun-Face Buddha, Moon-Face Buddha.'

red_pine.text: Master Mazu was ill. The abbot asked him, 'How is your health recently?' Mazu replied, 'Sun-faced Buddha, Moon-faced Buddha.'

sasaki.text: Master Mazu was ill. The abbot asked him, 'How is your health recently?' Mazu replied, 'Sun-faced Buddha, Moon-faced Buddha.'

cases.commentary_zh: 萬松老人云：此一則公案，直指人心，不可用思量卜度。
cases.commentary_en: Wansong says: This case points directly to the human mind; it cannot be measured by intellectual speculation.

cases.verse_en: Hongzhi's verse: The ancient Buddha's seal of mind penetrates straight to the bottom.

cases.pointer_zh: 示眾云：處處見真，不離當處；如何是主中之主？
cases.pointer_en: Pointer: Seeing reality everywhere without leaving the spot; what is the master of masters?

dialogue.speaker: Main Case / 本則
dialogue.zh: 僧問曹山：「清淨法身，作麼生？」山云：「病眼見華。」僧云：「如何是清淨法身主？」山云：「向這裏不得見。」
dialogue.pinyin: Sēng wèn Cáoshān: 'Qīngjìng fǎshēn, zuò mò shēng?' Shān yún: 'Bìng yǎn jiàn huá.' Sēng yún: 'Rúhé shì qīngjìng fǎshēn zhǔ?' Shān yún: 'Xiàng zhèlǐ bù dé jiàn.'

cleary.text: A monk asked Caoshan, 'What is the pure Dharma Body?' Caoshan said, 'A diseased eye seeing flowers.' The monk asked, 'Who is the master of the pure Dharma Body?' Caoshan said, 'Here you cannot see him.'

red_pine.text: A monk asked Master Caoshan, 'What is the immaculate Dharma Body?' Caoshan replied, 'An inflamed eye seeing blossoms.' The monk asked, 'Who is the lord of the Dharma Body?' Caoshan said, 'You cannot see him from here.'

sasaki.text: A monk asked Master Caoshan, 'What is the immaculate Dharma Body?' Caoshan replied, 'An inflamed eye seeing blossoms.' The monk asked, 'Who is the lord of the Dharma Body?' Caoshan said, 'You cannot see him from here.'
